title: The BBC Office Pilot with Lucy Davis

sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
And I'm Angela Kinsey.
We were on The Office together, and we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》，而且我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你们制作了这个终极《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节，还有许多我们闺蜜之间的故事。

sentences.en: We're the Office Lady 6.0.
Hello, everyone.
Welcome to Office Lady 6.0.
Today, we are going back to the very beginning of the world of The Office.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要回到《办公室》世界的最初起点。

sentences.en: And we have a special guest to help us travel back in time.
sentences.zh: 我们请到了一位特别嘉宾，带我们一起穿越回过去。

sentences.en: Angela, that is such a poetic way to describe this episode.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你描述这一集的方式真是太有诗意了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
I got here early.
I just had a lot of free time on my hands.
sentences.zh: 我刚好有很多空闲时间。

sentences.en: Maybe I overthought that one.
sentences.zh: 也许我刚才想得太多了。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know what got into me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我也不知道自己是怎么了。

sentences.en: I love an origin story.
What can I say?
Well, it is true that today we are starting at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实，今天我们要从头开始。

sentences.en: We have re-watched the BBC pilot of The Office.
sentences.zh: 我们重温了英版《办公室》的试播集。

sentences.en: And as it turns out, I have a connection to someone from the BBC office,
sentences.zh: 结果发现，我和英版《办公室》里的某个人有联系，

sentences.en: and they're joining us today.
You do.
Tell them who it is, lady.
My lady friend just texted Lucy Davis because they're pals.
sentences.zh: 我的这位女士朋友刚刚给露西·戴维斯发了短信，因为她们是好朋友。

sentences.en: Lucy plays Dawn Tinsley in the BBC The Office.
sentences.zh: 露西在英版《办公室》中饰演道恩·廷斯利。

sentences.en: She's joining us in the studio today to give us all the behind-the-scenes details of how the show began.
sentences.zh: 她今天会来到演播室，为我们揭秘这部剧最初是如何开始的幕后细节。

sentences.en: Well, you know Lucy from The Office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们通过《办公室》认识了露西。

sentences.en: And she was also in Shaun of the Dead, Wonder Woman, and Chilling Adventures of Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 她还出演过《僵尸肖恩》、《神奇女侠》和《萨布丽娜的惊心冒险》。

sentences.en: She's just the loveliest person and very, very funny.
sentences.zh: 她真的是个非常可爱、非常幽默的人。

sentences.en: We are so excited to have her here with us.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴她能来到这里。

sentences.en: Lady, she is the original Office lady.
sentences.zh: 女士，她才是最初的“办公室女士”。

sentences.en: She is.
So I think we should just jump right in.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我们应该直接开始吧。

sentences.en: Here we go.
Hello.
And guest here today, Lucy.
Hello.
It is Lucy Davis, you guys.
Dawn Tinsley.
Mm-hmm.
Dawn.
From The Original Office.
The UK version of The Office.
The OG.
Why we ever had jobs in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我们当初能有工作全靠它。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm glad this is down to me.
sentences.zh: 哦，很高兴这事儿落到我头上了。

sentences.en: Okay, good, good.
Thank you.
We can leave Rick and Steve way out of this.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把瑞克和史蒂夫排除在外。

sentences.en: Well, they're not here today.
They're not here.
So there we are.
There you go.
The show is mine.
That's right.
That's right.
You know, we're so excited to have you on today.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们很高兴你能来参加今天的节目。

sentences.en: We're going to break down the pilot episode of the BBC's The Office.
sentences.zh: 我们将深入剖析BBC版《办公室》的试播集。

sentences.en: Yeah.
You're going to take us through it.
We're going to ask you questions.
Yeah.
It's pretty cool.
But, you know, we always like to kick things off by asking people,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我们总是喜欢以一个问题作为开场，

sentences.en: how did you get your job on The Office?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的？

sentences.en: Oh, I tell you when it was 1999 and it was just everyone was breaking up for Christmas
sentences.zh: 噢，我告诉你，那是1999年，当时大家都准备放圣诞假了，

sentences.en: and I had auditioned for a bunch of comedy pilots, none of which I had particularly gelled with.
sentences.zh: 我试镜了一堆喜剧试播集，但没觉得哪个特别适合我。

sentences.en: It was still in a time when those, you know, live audience comedies were very, very broad
sentences.zh: 那时候，那种有现场观众的喜剧风格还非常非常夸张，

sentences.en: and nothing against that.
sentences.zh: 我并不是对那种风格有意见。

sentences.en: I just didn't fit easily into that.
sentences.zh: 只是我不太适合那种表演。

sentences.en: And so I went in and I auditioned.
Ricky Gervais wasn't there then.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇·热维斯当时不在场。

sentences.en: And I auditioned.
Then I got a call back and then Ricky was there and Steve Merchant.
sentences.zh: 后来我接到了回电，瑞奇和史蒂夫·莫昌特都在那儿。

sentences.en: And we were in a tiny room with an extremely large table.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个极小的房间里，里面放着一张特别大的桌子。

sentences.en: So you had to kind of shimmy your way around it.
sentences.zh: 所以你得侧着身子挪过去。

sentences.en: And I did a scene, which stayed in the pilot, where Dawn gets fake fired.
sentences.zh: 我演了一场戏，后来被保留在试播集里了，就是道恩被假装解雇的那场。

sentences.en: That's what I auditioned with.
sentences.zh: 那就是我试镜时演的内容。

sentences.en: That's what I auditioned with.
sentences.zh: 那就是我试镜时演的内容。

sentences.en: Oh my.
Okay.
But that's so funny.
That was our audition scene.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们的试镜片段。

sentences.en: Yeah.
That's mad.
Yeah.
And originally, I don't know what was in yours, but in ours, originally,
sentences.zh: 最初，我不知道你们那版是什么样，但在我们这版里，最初，

sentences.en: when Dawn then is crying and breaking down, Ricky tries to explain it's a joke.
sentences.zh: 当道恩哭着崩溃时，瑞奇试图解释这只是个玩笑。

sentences.en: She says something to him and walks out the room, but trips and falls.
sentences.zh: 她对他说了一些话，然后走出房间，却被绊倒了。

sentences.en: So when we were in this audition room, I was thinking, I'm not going to trip and fall
sentences.zh: 所以当我们在试镜室里时，我在想，我可不要绊倒，

sentences.en: because it just feels so weird and uncomfortable in this room.
sentences.zh: 因为在这个房间里感觉太奇怪、太不自在了。

sentences.en: Not uncomfortable in the good, uncomfortable way.
sentences.zh: 不是那种好的、让人不自在的感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Right.
So I didn't.
And then at the end of the scene, Ricky kept going as David Brent.
sentences.zh: 然后在那场戏结束时，瑞奇一直以大卫·布伦特的身份演下去。

sentences.en: And so I kept going.
And then after a while, I was like, yeah, I'm probably going to run out of things to say.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，我就想，好吧，我大概快没词儿说了。

sentences.en: So what do I do?
Oh, I know.
I'll just leave the room.
So I just exited the room and went.
sentences.zh: 于是我就走出了房间，然后离开了。

sentences.en: And then I just heard Ricky roaring.
sentences.zh: 接着我就听见瑞奇在咆哮。

sentences.en: I was like, apparently that was okay.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，看来那样做没问题。

sentences.en: And then I got it and I was really pleased.
sentences.zh: 后来我拿到了那个角色，真的非常高兴。

sentences.en: And I had to sign a contract, I think, for six years.
sentences.zh: 我记得我好像签了一份六年的合同。

sentences.en: And that was very new in England.
sentences.zh: 这在当时的英国是非常新鲜的事。

sentences.en: And now, of course, I couldn't be more glad to have got this job.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在我无比庆幸自己得到了这份工作。

sentences.en: Yeah.
It was a joy.
sentences.zh: 那真是一段快乐的时光。

sentences.en: And the fact that no one said, don't forget, this is a funny line, so really make it funny.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人会特意叮嘱说，别忘了，这句台词很有趣，一定要演得好笑一点。

sentences.en: Don't, you know, and everything had to just be as real as possible was my comfort zone.
sentences.zh: 不用那样，你知道，一切都要尽可能真实，这正是我感到自在的表演方式。

sentences.en: And my, like, no one had ever asked me to do that before.
sentences.zh: 而且，以前从来没有人要求我那样做。

sentences.en: It was all like, be a good actor, but it's acting.
sentences.zh: 以前总是被要求做一个好演员，但那是在“演戏”。

sentences.en: And now this is just being.
You were so good, though, your timing.
sentences.zh: 不过你演得真好，你的节奏感太棒了。

sentences.en: And when I watched it the first time, you know, years before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次看这部剧时，那是在美版播出前好几年。

sentences.en: version, I really didn't think it was scripted.
sentences.zh: 我真的以为那不是写好的剧本。

sentences.en: I was one of those people that thought they just, you know, I thought, well, David Brent is a crazy character of a person, but I'd also worked for some really weird bosses.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是那种人，我以为他们只是……你知道，我心想，大卫·布伦特是个疯狂的角色，但我以前也确实给一些很古怪的老板打过工。

sentences.en: And so I kind of bought it.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就信以为真了。

sentences.en: But I thought you were just in the moment.
sentences.zh: 但我以为你们只是在即兴发挥。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were.
It was really a joyous freedom.
sentences.zh: 那真是一种令人愉悦的自由。

sentences.en: I don't know if you felt this.
Just to, you know what's happening is also funny, but you just get to be.
sentences.zh: 就是，你知道发生的这一切本身就很有趣，你只需要沉浸其中。

sentences.en: You just get to be real.
sentences.zh: 你只需要表现得真实自然。

sentences.en: No one's trying to make a big thing about a joke and making sure you have three laughs a page and all of that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 没有人刻意去制造笑点，也不用确保每页纸都要有三个笑料之类的东西。

sentences.en: And that was a freedom for me.
I loved it.
The rhythm of it, like what Angela is saying and what you're talking about when I saw it again before I ever even knew I was going to audition.
sentences.zh: 那种节奏，就像安吉拉所说的，还有你刚才提到的，我在还没听说要试镜之前又看了一遍。

sentences.en: Before I even knew there would be this American version.
sentences.zh: 在甚至不知道会有美版之前。

sentences.en: I was just completely struck by how funny it was to be off rhythm and to sit in things for awkward amounts of time.
sentences.zh: 我完全被那种打破常规的节奏感所震撼，还有那种在尴尬时刻停顿的表演。

sentences.en: And it was a new comedic rhythm that you guys just invented together.
sentences.zh: 那是你们共同创造的一种全新的喜剧节奏。

sentences.en: It was so cool.
There was a show in England that had already started airing called The Royal Family, R-O-Y-L-E.
sentences.zh: 英国当时有一部已经播出的剧叫《罗伊一家》，拼写是R-O-Y-L-E。

sentences.en: And that was a similar style.
And if you've never seen The Royal Family, please see it.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看过《罗伊一家》，请一定要看。

sentences.en: If you guys have never seen it, it's so good.
sentences.zh: 如果你们还没看过，它真的非常棒。

sentences.en: It's so uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉非常令人坐立难安。

sentences.en: And it's really just a family on a couch in a living room.
sentences.zh: 它真的就是一家人坐在客厅的沙发上。

sentences.en: And anyway.
I can't wait to check it out.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想去看看了。

sentences.en: Yeah, check it out or I'll send you a link.
sentences.zh: 好啊，去看看吧，或者我发个链接给你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
But yeah, when I watched that, I remember thinking that would be a fun role as an actor to play.
sentences.zh: 不过确实，看那部剧的时候，我记得当时就在想，作为演员能演那样的角色一定很有趣。

sentences.en: So doing The Office, yeah, ever since then, I did my first multicam a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以后来演《办公室》，是的，从那以后，几年前我第一次尝试了多机位拍摄。

sentences.en: And I knew, of course, that the style isn't going to be The Office or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我当然知道，那种风格不会是《办公室》之类的。

sentences.en: But it was interesting for me and a strange experience to have to make so much of the comedy lines.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，必须把那么多喜剧台词演出来，这是一种很有趣且奇特的经历。

sentences.en: I was like, but if they're funny, they're funny.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，如果他们本身就很有趣，那他们就是很有趣。

sentences.en: You don't have to add a bell and whistle on it.
sentences.zh: 你没必要在上面画蛇添足。

sentences.en: Yeah.
So, yeah.
I came from sketch comedy.
Right.
And so, when I, my first scene, you know, the first, like, few lines I had, I thought, oh, I'm getting fired.
sentences.zh: 所以当我，拍第一场戏的时候，你知道，我前几句台词，我就想，完了，我要被炒鱿鱼了。

sentences.en: I was doing so much.
But I was because I was doing that.
sentences.zh: 但我当时就是那样演的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
But it is such a different style.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是完全不同的风格。

sentences.en: You guys did it so well.
But I have a question.
When you were filming the pilot, did you feel like, oh, we've got something here?
sentences.zh: 当你们在拍试播集的时候，有没有那种感觉，就是，噢，我们拍出好东西了？

sentences.en: Like, this is going to be a hit?
Because we felt that way.
sentences.zh: 因为我们当时就有这种感觉。

sentences.en: We didn't know if every—
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是不是每个人——

sentences.en: I wouldn't say a hit.
Well, no, but—
I thought—
I thought we had something special.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们拍出了特别的东西。

sentences.en: Amazing.
I didn't think anyone was going to watch it.
That's how I felt.
Yeah, that's the thing.
I was like, if people will watch this, it's going to be a hit.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，如果人们愿意看这个，它一定会火。

sentences.en: I don't know if they're going to watch it.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道他们会不会看。

sentences.en: Is that—that was your experience?
That's how I definitely felt.
I just remember really praying that it would go because I loved doing this so much.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时真的在祈祷它能成功，因为我太喜欢拍这个了。

sentences.en: And we made—I think I told you this, Jenna, that we actually made a pilot, and then we remade the pilot.
sentences.zh: 而且我们拍了——我想我跟你说过，珍娜，我们其实拍了一个试播集，然后又重拍了一次。

sentences.en: Yes.
And the original pilot, there were some different things.
sentences.zh: 最初的试播集里，有些地方不太一样。

sentences.en: But the biggest difference was there had been this documentary reality show in those very early days called—I think it was called Airline.
sentences.zh: 但最大的区别在于，在那个早期阶段，有一部纪录片式的真人秀，叫——我想是叫《航空公司》。

sentences.en: And it was just cameras following an airline in a smallish airport in England.
sentences.zh: 内容就是摄像机跟拍英国一个小机场的航空公司。

sentences.en: And it became huge.
And suddenly, like, these people were, like, famous.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这些人就变得很有名了。

sentences.en: And there was an actor called John Nettles who narrated the documentary.
sentences.zh: 而且有一位叫约翰·内特尔斯的演员为那部纪录片做了旁白。

sentences.en: So we had him narrate the pilot.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也让他为试播集做了旁白。

sentences.en: Oh.
Yeah.
To make it as real, like, kind of this genre and this style.
sentences.zh: 为了让它看起来更真实，就像那种类型和风格一样。

sentences.en: And—but then I think, I believe—this was such a long time ago now—but I believe they felt that it took time away from story and comedy.
sentences.zh: 然后——但后来我想，我相信——这已经是好久以前的事了——但我相信他们觉得这占用了故事和喜剧的时间。

sentences.en: So we redid it again and had—
sentences.zh: 所以我们又重拍了一次，并且让——

sentences.en: Without him.
Without the narration.
Yeah.
Yeah.
And the original theme tune just for that pilot was ELO's Mr. Blue Sky.
sentences.zh: 而且那个试播集最初的主题曲是ELO乐队的《蓝天先生》。

sentences.en: I remember that.
What?
That was our original theme song?
sentences.zh: 那是我们最初的主题曲吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
Yes.
Is that—I never knew that.
What?
Did you know that?
No.
No.
I'm getting chills.
Did Greg know that?
I don't know if Greg knew that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道格雷格知不知道。

sentences.en: But when I—when Greg gave us a screener of the pilot and we all got together and we watched it, the theme song was Mr. Blue Sky.
sentences.zh: 但当格雷格给我们试播集样片，我们聚在一起看的时候，主题曲是《Mr. Blue Sky》。

sentences.en: You have to ask him if he knew that that—because in ours, obviously, it never got aired.
sentences.zh: 你得问问他知不知道那件事——因为在我们的版本里，显然那首歌从未播出过。

sentences.en: Yeah, same.
Yeah, yeah.
But we couldn't—Greg told us, oh, we can't use that song because—
sentences.zh: 但我们没法——格雷格告诉我们，哦，我们不能用那首歌，因为——

sentences.en: Another show—
Another show nabbed it.
So then he had a friend who composed the song that we ultimately use.
sentences.zh: 所以他找了个朋友创作了我们最终使用的那首歌。

sentences.en: It's a great song, though.
Yours is a great song, though, too.
Yeah.
Because obviously ours was Stereophonics, and less than this, which is fine.
sentences.zh: 因为显然我们用的是Stereophonics乐队的歌，虽然没那么出名，但也挺好的。

sentences.en: They didn't give us permission to use their song, Handbanks of Gladrags.
sentences.zh: 他们没授权给我们用那首歌，《Handbags and Gladrags》。

sentences.en: So it was kind of rewritten to be that.
sentences.zh: 所以它被改写成了现在的样子。

sentences.en: And then when it got big, they said that we could use it, but we liked ours by that point.
sentences.zh: 后来剧火了，他们说我们可以用了，但那时候我们已经喜欢上自己的版本了。

sentences.en: And originally, with Mr. Blue Sky, the opening credits weren't images of Slough.
sentences.zh: 而且最初用《Mr. Blue Sky》的时候，片头画面也不是斯劳的景象。

sentences.en: It was David Brent walking into work all proud and pompous in his suit and his briefcase and stuff.
sentences.zh: 那是大卫·布伦特穿着西装、提着公文包，一脸自豪又自负地去上班的画面。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it was pretty different.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当时真的很不一样。

sentences.en: I love the opening images.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢现在的片头画面。

sentences.en: Same.
We were in London a few years ago.
We actually crossed paths, Jenna.
It was so fun.
But I was on a train with my husband and kids, and I didn't realize that we were going to go through Slough.
sentences.zh: 当时我和丈夫还有孩子们在火车上，我没意识到我们要经过斯劳。

sentences.en: And so I said to them, we have to get off.
sentences.zh: 所以我对他们说，我们必须下车。

sentences.en: And they're like, what?
This isn't our stop.
Oh, that's good.
And we jumped off really fast just so I could get a picture, and then we jumped back on the train.
sentences.zh: 我们飞快地跳下车，就为了拍张照，然后又跳回了火车上。

sentences.en: Did you post the picture?
I did.
I did.
